title: Tensor-side component data
statement: The tensor-chain, pure-tensor normalization and derived tensor comparison fields admit simultaneous choices.

proof.text: Construct the indicated component data by the corresponding sectionwise comparison, localization and representative normalization argument, then retain the displayed fields.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_core_tensor_data_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY) :
    Nonempty (ComparisonCoreTensorData l E g s SX SY TX TY)
